Bayesian Quantitative Trial Decision Rule

Source: R/class_design_quantitative.R
TrialDesignPlanQuantitativeBayes.Rd

Internal Bayesian decision-rule class. Obtain instances through getDesignQuantitative() with bayesian = TRUE or explicit criteria.

Stores validated Bayesian rules and optional references.

Returns the object description.

Arguments

go, stop, indeterminate1

Exclusive posterior criteria.

targetValue, lowerReferenceValue

Reference effects or NA.

upperPercentile, lowerPercentile

Reference percentiles or NA.

percentileMapping

Interpretation of reference percentiles.

startWithUpperCase

Capitalize the description.

Details

Inherits optional reference values and percentiles from TrialDesignPlanQuantitativeBase. These are NA for freely specified criteria. Go, Stop and Indeterminate 1 must be provably mutually exclusive for every continuous posterior CDF; Indeterminate 2 includes all remaining outcomes, including exact probability-threshold ties. Priors are supplied to the OC functions, rather than stored in the decision rule.

Fields

go

Supplied QuantitativeDecisionThresholds object defining the conjunction of Go criteria. Stored as a deep copy.

stop

Supplied QuantitativeDecisionThresholds object defining the conjunction of Stop criteria. Must be provably incompatible with the other explicit categories. Stored as a deep copy.

indeterminate1

Supplied QuantitativeDecisionThresholds object defining Indeterminate 1. Must exclude Go and Stop. Indeterminate 2 is the complement of the three explicit categories, including exact probability-threshold ties. Stored as a deep copy.

percentileMapping

Bayesian mapping for reference-value rules: quantile preserves posterior quantile comparisons, whereas posteriorProbability uses the percentiles as beneficial-tail thresholds. Has no statistical effect for explicit criteria. Is a single character value.

Inherited fields

lowerReferenceValue

Optional lower reference effect on the beneficial-effect scale. A supplied finite scalar for reference-value rules; NA for explicit Bayesian criteria.

upperPercentile

Upper percentile supplied for a reference-value rule, strictly between lowerPercentile and 1. NA for explicit Bayesian criteria. For Bayesian rules its interpretation is controlled by percentileMapping.

lowerPercentile

Lower percentile supplied for a reference-value rule, strictly between 0 and upperPercentile. NA for explicit Bayesian criteria. For Bayesian rules its interpretation is controlled by percentileMapping.

See also

getOperatingCharacteristicsMeans(), getOperatingCharacteristicsRates()
